title: OBC v3 Location Account Content
description: UTF-8 JSON stored in the publisher's location account (SPL Record account at CreateWithSeed(P, "obc-meta", recr1L3PCGKLbckBqMNcJhuuyU1zgo8nBhfLVsJNwr5)) after the 33-byte record header (version byte + authority). The JSON must be at most 900 bytes. Readers trim trailing 0x00 bytes before parsing.

s.description: Sequence number, incremented on every update.

b.description: Storage bases, newest/preferred first. Files are at {base}/{h}.json.

items.description: An https:// base URL without credentials or query string, or an opaque label 'label:<name>' that verifiers resolve from local configuration.

succ.description: Base58 address of another location account to use instead (key rotation). Verifiers follow at most 5 hops and stop on cycles.
